# 1_82

<span class="tada-chip tada-chip--muted">complete</span> <span class="tada-chip tada-chip--muted" title="Locked flights are released from the window; trained and scored in that environment">release MDP</span>

**What changed:** Search distillation, round 1: 1_76 fine-tuned by AWR-weighted behaviour cloning of the rollout search (601 search episodes on training seeds, AWR β 1, KL anchor 0.3 to 1_76, 6 epochs at LR 3e-5); this is epoch 4.

!!! note "Release MDP"
    This model trained in the release MDP, unlike the champion and every model before `1_49`: after each step the front of the landing queue is released once a flight is locked (predicted within 30 s of its target and in no predicted conflict). A released flight leaves the window and can no longer be cleared. It is scored in the same environment, on the same seeds and with the same metrics, so its numbers measure landings in the same scenarios, but under that extra constraint on the agent.

!!! info "About this run"
    Epoch 4 was selected on the 100 dev seeds (63 solved against 1_76&#x27;s 55, the best of nine checkpoints of 1_80 to 1_82, so optimistic). On seeds it was not selected on: test 61 against 1_76&#x27;s 59, validation 64 against 59 (this card), 300 dev seeds (the selection set plus 200 new) 176 against 166. The final_model.zip at the run root is epochs/e4. The dev-only variants 1_80, 1_81, 1_83 to 1_88 and 1_100 are not registered; see Search distillation.
